edges.reason: mintToken requires saleIsActive to allow minting
mintToken conditionally uses preSaleIsActive for presale gating
mintToken calls verify(proof) to check whitelist membership
mintToken enforces require(msg.sender == tx.origin) as its anti-contract restriction
msg.sender is compared against tx.origin in the anti-contract check
tx.origin feeds the require comparing with msg.sender
amount parameter drives the number of tokens minted
proof parameter is used for presale whitelist gating
proof array is passed into verify for merkle validation
mintToken reads MAX_TOKENS to bound totalSupply()+amount
mintToken reads WHITELIST_PRICE for presale pricing
mintToken reads PRICE for public pricing
PRICE is assigned into local price when presale condition fails
WHITELIST_PRICE is assigned into local price on presale path
price * amount multiplication is used in the msg.value sufficiency check
loop index i controls the repeated _safeMint calls
msg.sender is used both for the tx.origin check and as the mint recipient
setPrice writes the PRICE state variable
newPrice parameter is written into PRICE
setMaxTokens writes the MAX_TOKENS state variable
newMaxTokens parameter is written into MAX_TOKENS
flipSaleState toggles the saleIsActive flag
flipPreSaleState toggles the preSaleIsActive flag
withdraw10 executes an external ETH transfer to the owner
withdrawTotal executes an external ETH transfer of the full balance to the owner
transferReward executes an external ETH transfer to an arbitrary winner
winner parameter is the recipient of the reward transfer
amount parameter is the value of the reward transfer
setRoot writes the merkle root state variable
_root parameter is written into root
setBaseURI delegates to the internal _setBaseURI
baseURI parameter is forwarded by setBaseURI
_setBaseURI writes the _baseTokenURI state variable
verify reads the stored merkle root for comparison
msg.sender is hashed into the local merkle leaf
verify constructs and uses the leaf for MerkleProof.verify
getRandomNumber computes a predictable random value from chain and caller data
block.timestamp is used as entropy for the pseudo-random number
msg.sender is included in the randomness hash
pickWinner relies on getRandomNumber for winner selection
chances array parameter is iterated to find the winner
totalChance parameter bounds the random range
numWinner is computed via modulo totalChance, dividing by a caller supplied value
tokenURI calls _baseURI to build the metadata URI
tokenId parameter is used for existence check and URI construction
_baseURI reads the _baseTokenURI state variable
